name: West Coast Trail
region: Pacific Rim National Park Reserve, British Columbia
why: Seventy-five kilometres of rainforest, beaches, ladders and cable cars along the 'Graveyard of the Pacific', through Huu-ay-aht, Ditidaht and Pacheedaht lands.
book: Reservation required from Parks Canada for a start date (season 1 May to 30 September; bookings open in early winter), compulsory orientation at the trailhead, ferries at Nitinat Narrows and Gordon River. Bus or float plane between the ends.
water: Rivers and creeks; treat all water.
dangers: Tides: some beach stretches and headlands pass only at low tide; carry the tide table.
Ladders, cable cars and slippery logs: injuries and evacuations every season.
Rain and cold for days; surge channels on the shelf.
turnaround: Evacuation points only at set places: plan with the park map.
